# Dot

The smallest status mark in the design: a filled circle, optionally ringed by a slow pulse. It is never the only thing carrying a state — pair it with a word, or use `StatusDot`, which requires one.

## Anatomy

A circle at the given size, with an absolutely positioned ring drawn one pixel outside it when pulsing.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `string` | `'var(--text-primary)', size = 7, pulse = false` | A semantic colour token reference, never a literal. |
| `size` | `number` | — | — |
| `pulse` | `boolean` | — | The slow ring the reference uses for a live signal. Stilled under reduced motion. |

## Variants

None; colour and size are given by the caller as a token reference.

## States

Static, pulsing.

## Tokens consumed

| Token | Resolves to |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-dot-pulse-border` | `1.5px` |
| `--c-dot-pulse-inset` | `-1px` |
| `--motion-ease-out` | `ease-out` |
| `--motion-pulse` | `1.8s` |
| `--ui-radius-circle` | `50%` |

Every value resolves through a semantic or component token; `scripts/check-fidelity.mjs` fails on a literal.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

None — decorative by construction. Meaning belongs to the text beside it.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
- Under reduced motion the ring stops without the dot disappearing, so the state is still shown.
